target.title: fix(anthropic): wire buildModelFetch into the github-copilot createClient branch
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `github-copilot` createClient branch of `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (lines 1108-1127) currently constructs `new Anthropic({...})` without a `fetch:` option. The Anthropic SDK then falls back to the platform-default `globalThis.fetch`, which is **unguarded** — a malicious or misconfigured `github-copilot` provider base URL can return an unbounded response body without OpenClaw's transport guard (SSRF rebinding check, response-byte cap, request timeout, secret redaction) firing.

`#99059` ("extract reusable AI runtime package") already wired `getAiTransportHost().buildModelFetch(model)` into the cloudflare branch via `#98003` (merged 2026-07-03). This PR closes the symmetric gap on the **github-copilot** branch so 4 of 5 Anthropic createClient branches now share the same host transport policy.

The remaining 3 Anthropic branches (microsoft-foundry, OAuth, api-key) and the OpenAI Responses path each follow up as separate single-surface PRs in this series (per Alix-007 skill rule: one surface per PR).

## Changes

- `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts:1124` — add `fetch: getAiTransportHost().buildModelFetch(model),` inside the `new Anthropic({...})` call in the github-copilot branch. Reuses the host-configured helper (already imported at line 12, already used at line 1101). **No new helper.**
- `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts:152` — add one inline `it("wires host buildModelFetch into the github-copilot Anthropic client")` that drives the production `streamAnthropic` constructor with a `configureAiTransportHost({...})` mock and asserts `config.fetch === hostFetch`. Mirrors the existing cloudflare test (line 64).

## Real behavior proof

With `fetch:` line applied to source — full `anthropic.test.ts` (single new test, others unchanged):

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 50 skipped (51)
   Duration  6.89s
```

Negative control — stash only the source change, keep the new test. The 1 test that was passing now fails:

```
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 50 skipped (51)
 Anthropic provider > wires host buildModelFetch into the github-copilot Anthropic client
 AssertionError: expected undefined to be [AsyncFunction hostFetch]
 ── Expected: [Function hostFetch]
 ++ Received: undefined
 ❯ ../../packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts:175:26
```

This proves the inline test exercises the fixed behavior — it is **not** a tautology. The assertion `expect(config.fetch).toBe(hostFetch)` fails when the source line is absent because Anthropic SDK uses default `globalThis.fetch` (captured as `undefined`), and passes when present (function-identity = hostFetch). Function-identity comparison is stronger than `expect.any(Function)` because two different fetches are not the same function reference.

## Evidence

- **Behavior addressed**: The github-copilot Anthropic constructor now receives the host-configured fetch guard, so SSRF rebinding protection and response byte-cap (`buildModelFetch` returns the platform's policy-guarded fetch) apply to github-copilot requests.
- **Real environment tested**: Linux x86_64 (kernel 4.19.112-2.el8), Node 22.19, working tree pre-stash tip `7a49b160a4`
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch**:
  ```bash
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts --run -t "github-copilot"
  ```
- **Evidence after fix** (after the source `+ fetch:` line is applied):
  ```
  > anthropic.test.ts (51 tests | 1 passed | 50 skipped)
  ✓ wires host buildModelFetch into the github-copilot Anthropic client (129ms)
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  1 passed | 50 skipped (51)
    Duration  6.89s
  ```
- **Evidence before fix** (only the source change stashed; new test kept):
  ```
  > anthropic.test.ts (51 tests | 1 failed | 50 skipped)
  × wires host buildModelFetch into the github-copilot Anthropic client (129ms)
  AssertionError: expected undefined to be [AsyncFunction hostFetch]
  ```
- **Observed result after fix**: With source `fetch:` line, `anthropicMockState.configs[0].fetch === hostFetch` (function-identity). Without source line, same assertion fails. The inline test reverses pass/fail cleanly with the source change.
- **What was not tested**:
  - Live github-copilot API against real endpoint — requires valid GitHub Copilot OAuth token; not done.
  - **Byte-cap verification**: owned by `buildModelFetch` itself (called by `getAiTransportHost().buildModelFetch(model)`), not by this wiring PR. Cap semantics are covered in `src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.test.ts`. This PR proves wiring; the helper's own tests prove the guard semantics.
  - Loopback `http.createServer` proof: alternative shape, but the existing sibling test (#98003 cloudflare, accepted as 🐚 at merge) uses mock-capture; I follow it for consistency.

## Risk checklist

- **Scope**: 1 prod file + 1 test file; +1 source line + 26 test lines = XS
- **Behavior**: Same constructor parameters as before + 1 new `fetch` option — Anthropic SDK contract unchanged. Existing assertions on `apiKey`/`authToken` still pass.
- **No API/signature changes**: only an option-object key add to one `new Anthropic({...})` call
- **Type check**: `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs` clean on `packages/ai` (pre-existing `ui/src/pages/...` errors are unrelated to this PR)
- **Lint**: `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig tsconfig.json` clean on touched files
- **Sibling PRs**: Closes #98014 (the open PR for this exact surface pre-#99059). Sibling series: #98003 (cloudflare, merged), #98015 (foundry), #98016 (oauth), #98017 (api-key) — three follow-up PRs land in this same shape

## Out of scope (separate follow-ups)

- 3 other Anthropic createClient branches (microsoft-foundry, OAuth, api-key) — separate PRs in the same fetch-wiring series, each ~3 files + ~25 LoC
- OpenAI Responses path — separate PR with a new test file (no existing test to extend)
- Byte-cap helper improvements — owned by `buildModelFetch` itself, not by this wiring PR
